name: Hidden Archers
summary: These are hooded archers. It seems like their glowing eyes see far more than just the target ...
legend: No one sees the Hidden Archers arrive. Travellers only notice a single glowing slit in the dark beneath a hood, and then the trees go quiet. The oldest tales talk about the Crimson Shadow Archer, wrapped in blood-red hood and iron-grey sleeves. He walked beside the Emerald Forest Archer, whose green eye shone through the leaves like a firefly. Later, others came out of places no map shows. The Frost Shadow Archer brought a cold cyan stare down from the glaciers. From the dunes came the Desert Sand Archer, a gold figure with one burning amber eye. Every hood hides a different light, and every light belongs to a different land. The tales agree on just one thing: the archers keep watching even when the hood is empty. And somewhere past the horizon, more eyes are opening ...

versions.title: Crimson Shadow and Emerald Forest

skins.name: Crimson Shadow Archer
skins.story: The first to wear the hood, the Crimson Shadow Archer moves in blood-red and iron-grey, and his pale eye is the last thing his enemies see.

skins.name: Emerald Forest Archer
skins.story: Wrapped in green hood and worn leather, the Emerald Forest Archer becomes part of the woods, and only a faint green eye gives her away.

versions.note: The first two hoods appear: the Crimson Shadow Archer and the Emerald Forest Archer step out of the treeline, one red as blood and one green as moss.

skins.name: Midnight Void Archer
skins.story: Born from purple-black nothing, the Midnight Void Archer waits in the dark with pale lavender hands and an eye like a dying star.

skins.name: Desert Sand Archer
skins.story: Gold as the dunes at noon, the Desert Sand Archer crosses the desert unseen, and one amber eye burns beneath the hood.

skins.name: Frost Shadow Archer
skins.story: The Frost Shadow Archer comes down from the glaciers in ice-blue armour, and his cold cyan eye can freeze a hunter in place.

versions.note: Three new eyes open far from the forest: the Midnight Void Archer, the Desert Sand Archer and the Frost Shadow Archer join the watch.

skins.name: Toxic Shadow Archer
skins.story: Covered in poison-green moss, the Toxic Shadow Archer stalks the swamps, and his yellow eye glows like venom in the mist.

skins.name: Dusk Ember Archer
skins.story: Copper-red like the last light of sunset, the Dusk Ember Archer hunts at twilight, and her amber eye glows like a coal that won't go out.

versions.note: Two more come out of the swamp mist and the fading sunset: the Toxic Shadow Archer and the Dusk Ember Archer.
